info.name: Distributed Wallet — manual walkthrough
info.description: Also import the Distributed Wallet local environment. Run items 00–27 in order using Send or the Runner. Each protected request obtains a fresh Keycloak token; IDs are saved automatically. Request 02 starts a new wallet. Expected final state: balance 85.00, version 5, five entries. Negative tests expect 400/401/403/404/409/422 and should pass. This walkthrough creates persistent data without deleting data or restarting services. It covers HTTP; a separate collection covers HTTP concurrency, while the Go suite also covers SQS and crashes.

request.description: Run this request to start or restart the walkthrough. It generates a new player and wallet without deleting previous ones, and saves walletId and playerId automatically.
